title: Jev decision client and CI failure triage: flaky, infra or real regression, advisory only

AC1.note: src/harness/decision/jev-client.ts: callJevSystemOne(fetchFn=globalThis.fetch, {model,state,questions}) -> {answers,usage}; no vendor SDK, no ProviderPort import. jev-client.test.ts AC1/AC4 describe block (2 tests).

AC2.note: resolveJevApiKey() reuses envWithSavedApiKeys (src/lib/shell-config.ts); JevCredentialError thrown, 0 fetch calls, when absent. jev-client.test.ts AC2 describe block (2 tests).

AC3.note: preflightBudget() reuses estimateTokens (src/review/cost.ts); JevBudgetError names state|questions side, refused before any fetch call. jev-client.test.ts AC3 describe block (4 tests).

AC4.note: JEV_MODEL_1_13, JEV_MODEL_LATEST, DEFAULT_JEV_MODEL exported constants in jev-client.ts; every call site (review.ts, ci-triage-source.ts) references DEFAULT_JEV_MODEL, no duplicated literal.

AC5.note: Injected fake fetch in every test; jev-client.test.ts AC5 describe block: success, malformed-JSON, non-200, missing-usage, missing-answers, each its own test (5 tests, no real socket).

AC6.note: src/review/ci-port.ts: createGhCiPort/createFixtureCiPort, 3 read methods only (runInfo, failedLog, recentRuns); job-name history approximated at workflow granularity (documented in file header, gh has no bulk per-job endpoint). ci-port.test.ts (9 tests).

AC7.note: FINDING: OpenRouter TypeSafe SDK guide documents no per-option-probability shape for a choice answer (only the chosen option); confirmed independently in docs/requirements/keryx-jev-router/PRD.md §13. Implemented as 3 noul questions (flaky/infra/real-regression) instead of 1 choice question, giving a true probability per option. src/review/ci-triage.ts buildCiTriageQuestions/computeCiTriageVerdict/renderCiTriageAdvisory; advisory text always labelled ADVISORY ONLY, never triggers rerun/merge/status-check. ci-triage.test.ts AC7 block (4 tests).

AC8.note: keryx review ci-triage --run <id> [--job][--test][--repo][--model][--fixtures][--json] wired in src/commands/review.ts (runCiTriage); no other reviewer/round required. review-ci-triage-cli.test.ts AC8 block (4 tests) driven through the real CLI with fixtures built from a real failed run on this repo (36095133327).

AC9.note: CiPort has exactly 3 read methods, no write method at all (structural proof). ci-port.test.ts AC9 tests assert the live adapter's argv never contains rerun/cancel/delete/POST-PUT-PATCH-DELETE and the fixture port's method set is exactly {runInfo,failedLog,recentRuns}. review-ci-triage-cli.test.ts and ci-triage-source.test.ts also assert no such call/argv appears.

AC10.note: readCiTriageEnabled() reads review.jev.ci_triage from .metaproject/tasks.config.json, default false, mirrors readRequireConfirmationDefault's pattern exactly. CLI and TUI paths both check opt-in + credential BEFORE touching the CI port or Jev client. ci-triage.test.ts AC10 (5 tests), review-ci-triage-cli.test.ts AC10 (2 tests, proving a nonexistent --fixtures dir is never opened when refused), ci-triage-source.test.ts (2 equivalent tests for the TUI path).

AC11.note: buildCiTriageState() bounds the log to CI_TRIAGE_LOG_CHARS=6000 chars (tail-first, well inside the 64k budget) and runs redactSensitiveText BEFORE truncation. ci-triage.test.ts AC11 block (4 tests) including a planted-secret test; revert-checked by disabling redaction and confirming the test fails, then restoring (see conversation notes / PR description).

AC12.note: TUI /ci: src/tui/ci-triage-inspector.ts (list+detail modal, follows triggers-inspector.ts/governance-inspector.ts conventions: modal-host, keyboardOwnedElsewhere via inputBlocked, guardedThemeRepaint) + src/tui/ci-triage-source.ts (production gh+Jev loader/triager for the current branch's PR), wired into tui-shell.ts (/ci dispatch) and agent-commands.ts. Detail view uses renderCiTriageAdvisory, always labelled ADVISORY ONLY. ci-triage-inspector.test.ts (7 tests, real OpenTUI renderer, 0 skips) + ci-triage-source.test.ts (7 tests, injected gh spawn + fetch, no real network).

AC13.note: keryx review ci-triage: dispatch in review.ts, usage/detail text in printHelp(). HELP_GROUPS: /ci slash entry added (Managed work); review verb already covered (subcommand, matches budget/tier/comments precedent). CLI reference: docs/docs/cli-reference.md usage line + subcommand table row + new ### review ci-triage section stating limits (opt-in privacy decision, advisory-only by construction, vendor-reported-accuracy-only). All English. cli-reference-coverage.test.ts, help-groups.test.ts, commands-by-task.test.ts (regenerated) all pass.

AC14.note: CI is green on the merge commit 45df98bdafd11b292990addf50e311d2072a048c (origin/main tip, PR #704 squash-merge): gh api repos/MrCipherSmith/keryx/commits/45df98bdafd11b292990addf50e311d2072a048c/check-runs shows 19/19 checks completed success (typecheck-and-tests confirmed completed success by polling; 18 others were already green). keryx health run, executed by me in a worktree checked out at 45df98bdafd11b292990addf50e311d2072a048c: Code Health PASS, project score 94, no gate conditions triggered.
